name: git-tools
description: Use Git porcelain safely with atomic Korean commits, evidence-led history, recovery, and risk-aware local and remote operations.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Git porcelain and atomic Korean commits
interface.longDescription: Use Git as a primary porcelain toolkit: inspect history, split mixed work into atomic Korean commits, manage worktrees and branches, integrate or rewrite history, operate remotes with explicit approvals, and recover safely.
defaultPrompt: 변경사항을 작업 단위로 나눠 원자적으로 커밋해줘.
현재 브랜치를 main 위로 안전하게 rebase해줘.
Git 이력을 조사하고 필요한 복구 작업까지 진행해줘.
